record_title: The multi-stage ARP product factor is asymptotically sharp
provenance: Sharpness analysis of the multi-stage adaptive randomized pivoting and conditional projection-DPP guarantee in arXiv:2609.20556, with comparison to one-shot ARP and classical volume-sampling CSSP bounds.
limitations: The construction is adversarial and nearly rank deficient; it establishes expected Frobenius-error sharpness for MSARP/CSSP but not spectral-norm, Nyström, or high-probability lower bounds.
